preview.tournamentOverview: Albany GC is a 7,400-yard, par-72 layout that rewards elite ball-striking and scrambling. SG Total 7%), SG Around-the-Green 6%), and SG Off-the-Tee 5%) dominate the model, while SG Approach 7%) and SG Putting 1%) carry less weight. The Hero World Challenge is a 20-man, no-cut exhibition that awards Official World Golf Ranking points and serves as a final tune-up before the new year.
preview.modelExplainer: The model weights SG Total highest at 7% because overall scoring is the clearest predictor of success. SG Around-the-Green 6%) and SG Off-the-Tee 5%) follow closely, reflecting Albany's emphasis on recovery shots and distance control off the tee. SG Putting 1%) and SG Approach 7%) are secondary, while ancillary stats like Driving Accuracy 4%) and Bogey Avoidance 0%) provide minor adjustments.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by a blend of tournamentRank and powerRank, prioritizing those who post strong SG numbers in the heavily weighted categories. Top-tier bets focus on golfers inside the top five of both lists who excel in SG Total and SG Around-the-Green. Mid-tier exposure targets players with outlier SG marks in a single key category, while long-shot consideration is limited to names whose powerRank significantly outpaces their current form.
